# War Scroll Column 11 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 11 | **Condition:** complete

---

**11:1** You are a terri[ble] God in the glory of Your kingdom, and the congregation of Your holy ones is in our midst as an eternal help. We shall direct our contempt at kings, our scorn and mockery at

**11:2** mighty men. For the Lord is holy, and the King of Glory is with us, together with the holy ones. Valiant warriors of the angelic host are among our ranks,

**11:3** and the Hero of War is in our congregation; the host of His spirits marches with our steps. Our horsemen come like clouds

**11:4** and like mist of dew covering the earth, like a shower of rain pouring out justice upon all that grows from her. Arise, you

**11:5** who lie in the dust! Worms of the dead, lift yourselves up to meet [...] Gird yourselves and stand! For who is like Your people Israel, whom You chose

**11:6** for Yourself from all the peoples of the earth? A people of the saints of the covenant, learned in the Torah, wise in understanding,

**11:7** who hear the voice of the Honored One and behold the holy angels, whose ears are opened; who hear profound things and perceive the design of

**11:8** the ages of eternity. We shall heap contempt upon kings, mockery and scorn upon mighty men. For the Lord

**11:9** is holy, and the King of Glory is with us, together with the holy ones. Mighty warriors of the angelic host are among our numbered ones, and the Hero

**11:10** of War is in our congregation; the host of His spirits is with our steps. Our horsemen come like clouds, like mist

**11:11** of dew to cover the earth, like a torrent of rain showering justice upon all that grows from her. For the God of Israel has called forth

**11:12** a sword against all the nations, and through the holy ones of His people He shall do mighty deeds. Arise, O Hero! Take

**11:13** Your captives, O Glorious One! Gather Your spoil, O Doer of Valor! Set Your hand upon the neck of Your enemies

**11:14** and Your foot upon the heaps of the slain. Strike the nations, Your adversaries, and let Your sword devour

**11:15** guilty flesh. Fill Your land with glory and Your inheritance with blessing; may there be abundance of livestock in Your territory,

**11:16** silver and gold and precious stones in Your palaces. O Zion, rejoice exceedingly! Shine forth in songs of joy,

**11:17** O Jerusalem! Exult, all you cities of Judah! Open your gates continually, that the wealth of the nations may be brought in to you. Their kings shall minister to you, and all your oppressors shall bow before you, and they shall lick the dust of your feet. The dominion belongs to You, and in Your hand is the battle of all.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 11 contains the great victory hymn, with liturgical repetition of key phrases in lines 1-4 and 8-11. "Hero of War" is a divine epithet unique to 1QM. The closing lines (16-17) draw heavily on Isaiah 60:11-14 and Psalm 24 ("King of Glory"). Formal register preserved throughout.*
